answer: Use a random roll-call gate. A newcomer locks a $60 bond, joins the atlas of verified agents, and must answer three surprise video roll-calls in 10 minutes, over 14 days. Two established agents check each call against the registered profile. Miss two and the bond burns, plus a 30-day wait. A timber lodge hosts the desk and signs each call record. Forging 1,000 fakes needs $60,000 in bonds and 3,000 answered calls, about 500 staffed hours, and no script fakes a live face on demand. Like a velvet rope: one bouncer can be fooled, but three surprise checks keep the fakes out.
